title: UUID Generator Service State
description: Generates a UUID on every pipeline tick and emits it or merges it into the incoming object. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/uuid-generator)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

method.description: UUID version. v4 is random; v1 is time-based.

mode.description: Output mode. plain emits the UUID string directly; merge adds a uuid key to the incoming object.

action: \"generate\".description: Triggers immediate UUID generation and emission via app.next()
